@dev Contract module that allows children to implement role-based access
 control mechanisms. This is a lightweight version that doesn't allow enumerating role
 members except through off-chain means by accessing the contract event logs. Some
 applications may benefit from on-chain enumerability, for those cases see
 {AccessControlEnumerable}.
 Roles are referred to by their `bytes32` identifier. These should be exposed
 in the external API and be unique. The best way to achieve this is by
 using `public constant` hash digests:
 ```
 bytes32 public constant MY_ROLE = keccak256("MY_ROLE");
 ```
 Roles can be used to represent a set of permissions. To restrict access to a
 function call, use {hasRole}:
 ```
 function foo() public {
     require(hasRole(MY_ROLE, msg.sender));
     ...
 }
 ```
 Roles can be granted and revoked dynamically via the {grantRole} and
 {revokeRole} functions. Each role has an associated admin role, and only
 accounts that have a role's admin role can call {grantRole} and {revokeRole}.
 By default, the admin role for all roles is `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, which means
 that only accounts with this role will be able to grant or revoke other
 roles. More complex role relationships can be created by using
 {_setRoleAdmin}.
 WARNING: The `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is also its own admin: it has permission to
 grant and revoke this role. Extra precautions should be taken to secure
 accounts that have been granted it.

@dev Contract module that helps prevent reentrant calls to a function.
 Inheriting from `ReentrancyGuard` will make the {nonReentrant} modifier
 available, which can be applied to functions to make sure there are no nested
 (reentrant) calls to them.
 Note that because there is a single `nonReentrant` guard, functions marked as
 `nonReentrant` may not call one another. This can be worked around by making
 those functions `private`, and then adding `external` `nonReentrant` entry
 points to them.
 TIP: If you would like to learn more about reentrancy and alternative ways
 to protect against it, check out our blog post
 https://blog.openzeppelin.com/reentrancy-after-istanbul/[Reentrancy After Istanbul].

@dev Returns true if `account` is a contract.
 [IMPORTANT]
 ====
 It is unsafe to assume that an address for which this function returns
 false is an externally-owned account (EOA) and not a contract.
 Among others, `isContract` will return false for the following
 types of addresses:
  - an externally-owned account
  - a contract in construction
  - an address where a contract will be created
  - an address where a contract lived, but was destroyed
 ====
 [IMPORTANT]
 ====
 You shouldn't rely on `isContract` to protect against flash loan attacks!
 Preventing calls from contracts is highly discouraged. It breaks composability, breaks support for smart wallets
 like Gnosis Safe, and does not provide security since it can be circumvented by calling from a contract
 constructor.
 ====

@dev Replacement for Solidity's `transfer`: sends `amount` wei to
 `recipient`, forwarding all available gas and reverting on errors.
 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1884[EIP1884] increases the gas cost
 of certain opcodes, possibly making contracts go over the 2300 gas limit
 imposed by `transfer`, making them unable to receive funds via
 `transfer`. {sendValue} removes this limitation.
 https://diligence.consensys.net/posts/2019/09/stop-using-soliditys-transfer-now/[Learn more].
 IMPORTANT: because control is transferred to `recipient`, care must be
 taken to not create reentrancy vulnerabilities. Consider using
 {ReentrancyGuard} or the
 https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/v0.5.11/security-considerations.html#use-the-checks-effects-interactions-pattern[checks-effects-interactions pattern].

@dev Performs a Solidity function call using a low level `call`. A
 plain `call` is an unsafe replacement for a function call: use this
 function instead.
 If `target` reverts with a revert reason, it is bubbled up by this
 function (like regular Solidity function calls).
 Returns the raw returned data. To convert to the expected return value,
 use https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/units-and-global-variables.html?highlight=abi.decode#abi-encoding-and-decoding-functions[`abi.decode`].
 Requirements:
 - `target` must be a contract.
 - calling `target` with `data` must not revert.
 _Available since v3.1._

Note that because there is a single `nonReentrant` guard, functions marked as `nonReentrant` may not call one another. This can be worked around by making those functions `private`, and then adding `external` `nonReentrant` entry points to them. TIP: If you would like to learn more about reentrancy and alternative ways to protect against it, check out our blog post https://blog.openzeppelin.com/reentrancy-after-istanbul/[Reentrancy After Istanbul].
Interface of the ERC20 standard as defined in the EIP.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. IMPORTANT: Beware that changing an allowance with this method brings the risk that someone may use both the old and the new allowance by unfortunate transaction ordering. One possible solution to mitigate this race condition is to first reduce the spender's allowance to 0 and set the desired value afterwards: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/20#issuecomment-263524729 Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `account`.

totalSupply().details: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Moves `amount` tokens from the caller's account to `to`. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Moves `amount` tokens from `from` to `to` using the allowance mechanism. `amount` is then deducted from the caller's allowance. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. Emits a {Transfer} event.

devdoc.details: Interface of the ERC20 Permit extension allowing approvals to be made via signatures, as defined in https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612[EIP-2612]. Adds the {permit} method, which can be used to change an account's ERC20 allowance (see {IERC20-allowance}) by presenting a message signed by the account. By not relying on {IERC20-approve}, the token holder account doesn't need to send a transaction, and thus is not required to hold Ether at all.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value must be included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}. Every successful call to {permit} increases ``owner``'s nonce by one. This prevents a signature from being used multiple times.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over ``owner``'s tokens, given ``owner``'s signed approval. IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction ordering also apply here. Emits an {Approval} event. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `deadline` must be a timestamp in the future. - `v`, `r` and `s` must be a valid `secp256k1` signature from `owner` over the EIP712-formatted function arguments. - the signature must use ``owner``'s current nonce (see {nonces}). For more information on the signature format, see the https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612#specification[relevant EIP section].

// OpenZeppelin Contracts v4.4.1 (token/ERC20/extensions/draft-IERC20Permit.sol)

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC20 Permit extension allowing approvals to be made via signatures, as defined in
 * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612[EIP-2612].
 *
 * Adds the {permit} method, which can be used to change an account's ERC20 allowance (see {IERC20-allowance}) by
 * presenting a message signed by the account. By not relying on {IERC20-approve}, the token holder account doesn't
 * need to send a transaction, and thus is not required to hold Ether at all.
 */
interface IERC20Permit {
    /**
     * @dev Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over ``owner``'s tokens,
     * given ``owner``'s signed approval.
     *
     * IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction
     * ordering also apply here.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `deadline` must be a timestamp in the future.
     * - `v`, `r` and `s` must be a valid `secp256k1` signature from `owner`
     * over the EIP712-formatted function arguments.
     * - the signature must use ``owner``'s current nonce (see {nonces}).
     *
     * For more information on the signature format, see the
     * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612#specification[relevant EIP
     * section].
     */
    function permit(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external;

    /**
     * @dev Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value must be
     * included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}.
     *
     * Every successful call to {permit} increases ``owner``'s nonce by one. This
     * prevents a signature from being used multiple times.
     */
    function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.
     */
    // solhint-disable-next-line func-name-mixedcase
    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32);
}

devdoc.details: Wrappers around ERC20 operations that throw on failure (when the token contract returns false). Tokens that return no value (and instead revert or throw on failure) are also supported, non-reverting calls are assumed to be successful. To use this library you can add a `using SafeERC20 for IERC20;` statement to your contract, which allows you to call the safe operations as `token.safeTransfer(...)`, etc.

devdoc.details: Implementation of the {IERC165} interface. Contracts that want to implement ERC165 should inherit from this contract and override {supportsInterface} to check for the additional interface id that will be supported. For example: ```solidity function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override returns (bool) {     return interfaceId == type(MyInterface).interfaceId || super.supportsInterface(interfaceId); } ``` Alternatively, {ERC165Storage} provides an easier to use but more expensive implementation.

Interface of the ERC165 standard, as defined in the https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165[EIP]. Implementers can declare support of contract interfaces, which can then be queried by others ({ERC165Checker}). For an implementation, see {ERC165}.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[EIP section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

params.requestId: The ID of the request to accept

returns.recordId: The ID of the co-signing record

params.coSignRecordId: The ID of the co-signing record

params.requestId: The ID of the request to cancel

params.loanOfferId: The ID of the loan offer

returns.requestId: The ID of the created request

returns._0: openRequests Array of active CoSigningRequest structs
count The number of times co-signed

params.recordId: The ID of the co-signing record

returns.totalBonus: The total bonus from all co-signers

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

returns._0: hasDR True if diminishing returns apply

params.recordId: The ID of the co-signing record
params.successfulRepayment: Whether the loan was repaid successfully

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LendingPool.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title CoSigningManager\r\n * @notice Manages co-signing relationships where trusted users can vouch for borrowers\r\n * @dev Integrates with ReputationManager and LendingPool for reputation staking\r\n */\r\ncontract CoSigningManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    LendingPool public immutable lendingPool;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextRequestId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextRecordId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRequest) public coSigningRequests;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRecord) public coSigningRecords;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanCoSigners; // loanId => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userRequests; // borrower => requestIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userCoSignings; // coSigner => recordIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Co-signing limits\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION = 200;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE = 50; // 50% of co-signer's reputation\r\n    uint256 public constant COOLDOWN_PERIOD = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN = 3;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRequest {\r\n        uint256 requestId;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n        string message;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRecord {\r\n        uint256 recordId;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        uint256 reputationStaked;\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided;\r\n        uint256 coSignTimestamp;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        bool loanCompleted;\r\n        bool borrowerDefaulted;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string message\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningCompleted(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningReleased(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerPenalized(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerRewarded(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 rewardAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _reputationManager, address _lendingPool) {\r\n        if (_reputationManager == address(0) || _lendingPool == address(0)) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        lendingPool = LendingPool(_lendingPool);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Request Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Create a co-signing request for a loan offer\r\n     * @param loanOfferId The ID of the loan offer\r\n     * @param requestedBonus The reputation bonus requested\r\n     * @param message Optional message to potential co-signers\r\n     * @return requestId The ID of the created request\r\n     */\r\n    function createCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string calldata message\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {\r\n        if (requestedBonus == 0) revert CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n\r\n        // Verify loan offer exists\r\n        LendingPool.LoanOffer memory offer = lendingPool.getLoanOffer(\r\n            loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n\r\n        requestId = nextRequestId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRequests[requestId] = CoSigningRequest({\r\n            requestId: requestId,\r\n            borrower: msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId: loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus: requestedBonus,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp,\r\n            message: message\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userRequests[msg.sender].push(requestId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n            requestId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus,\r\n            message\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return requestId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel a co-signing request\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRequest(uint256 requestId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (request.borrower != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCancelled(requestId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a co-signing request and stake reputation\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request to accept\r\n     * @return recordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     */\r\n    function acceptCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 recordId) {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (msg.sender == request.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n\r\n        // Check co-signer reputation\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            msg.sender\r\n        );\r\n        if (coSignerReputation < MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Calculate actual bonus with diminishing returns\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided = reputationManager.addCoSigningBonus(\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            coSignerReputation\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        recordId = nextRecordId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRecords[recordId] = CoSigningRecord({\r\n            recordId: recordId,\r\n            coSigner: msg.sender,\r\n            borrower: request.borrower,\r\n            loanId: 0, // Will be set when loan is matched\r\n            reputationStaked: coSignerReputation,\r\n            bonusProvided: bonusProvided,\r\n            coSignTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            loanCompleted: false,\r\n            borrowerDefaulted: false\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userCoSignings[msg.sender].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate request\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            0,\r\n            bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return recordId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add co-signer to an      if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        // Verify loan exists and borrower matches\r\n        LendingPool.Loan memory loan = lendingPool.getLoan(loanId);\r\n        if (loan.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n        if (loan.borrower != record.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        // Check max co-signers limit\r\n        if (loanCoSigners[loanId].length >= MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Link record to loan\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(coSignRecordId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            coSignRecordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Release co-signing after loan completion\r\n     * @param recordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     * @param successfulRepayment Whether the loan was repaid successfully\r\n     */\r\n    function releaseCoSigning(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n\r\n        if (successfulRepayment) {\r\n            // Reward co-signer\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(record.coSigner, record.borrower);\r\n\r\n            emit CoSignerRewarded(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                10\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Penalize co-signer\r\n            record.borrowerDefaulted = true;\r\n\r\n            // Calculate penalty amount (done by ReputationManager)\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            emit CoSignerPenalized(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked / 3\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            successfulRepayment\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate co-signing bonus for a borrower-coSigner pair\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @param coSigner The address of the co-signer\r\n     * @return bonus The calculated bonus amount\r\n     */\r\n    function calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 bonus) {\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            coSigner\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Base bonus: up to 50% of co-signer's reputation\r\n        uint256 baseBonus = (coSignerReputation * MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE) / 100;\r\n\r\n        // Apply diminishing returns based on history\r\n        uint256 coSignCount = reputationManager.getCoSignCount(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            borrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (coSignCount == 0) {\r\n            return baseBonus; // 100%\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 1) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 60) / 100; // 60%\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 2) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 30) / 100; // 30%\r\n        } else {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 10) / 100; // 10%\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing record details\r\n     * @param recordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     * coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing request details\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request\r\n     * @return request The CoSigningRequest struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all co-signing requests for a borrower\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @return requests Array of request IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userRequests[borrower];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get getActiveCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory requestIds = userRequests[borrower];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        // Count active requests\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeCount++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Build array\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory activeRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRequests[index] = coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]];\r\n                index++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all co-signing records coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userCoSignings[coSigner];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all active co-signing records for a user\r\n = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeCount++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Build array\r\n        CoSigningRecord[] memory activeRecords = new CoSigningRecord[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRecords[index] = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n                index++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRecords;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all co-signers for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return coSigners Array of co-signer addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCoSigners(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = loanCoSigners[loanId];\r\n        address[] memory coSigners = new address[](recordIds.length);\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            coSigners[i] = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].coSigner;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return coSigners;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get total reputation bonus provided to a borrower for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return totalBonus The total bonus from all co-signers\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanTotalBonus(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 totalBonus) {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = loanCoSigners[loanId];\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            totalBonus += coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].bonusProvided;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return totalBonus;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check how many times a co-signer has co-signed for a borrower\r\n     * @param coSigner The address of the co-signer\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @return count The number of times co-signed\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSignCount(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return reputationManager.getCoSignCount(coSigner, borrower);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if diminishing returns apply for a co-signer-borrower pair\r\n     * @param coSigner The address of the co-signer\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the returns (bool) {\r\n        return reputationManager.hasDiminishingReturns(coSigner, borrower);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing statistics for a user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return totalCoSignings Total number of co-signings\r\n     * @return activeCoSignings Current active co-signings\r\n     * @return successfulCoSignings Successful completions\r\n     * @return defaultedCoSignings Defaulted loans\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningStats(\r\n        address user\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (\r\n            uint256 totalCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 activeCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 successfulCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 defaultedCoSignings\r\n        )\r\n    {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n\r\n        totalCoSignings = recordIds.length;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord memory record = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (record.isActive) {\r\n                activeCoSignings++;\r\n            } else if (record.loanCompleted) {\r\n                if (record.borrowerDefaulted) {\r\n                    defaultedCoSignings++;\r\n                } else {\r\n                    successfulCoSignings++;\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return (\r\n            totalCoSignings,\r\n            activeCoSignings,\r\n            successfulCoSignings,\r\n            defaultedCoSignings\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all open co-signing requests (for discovery)\r\n     * @return openRequests Array of active CoSigningRequest structs\r\n     */\r\n    function getAllOpenRequests()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        uint256 totalRequests = nextRequestId - 1;\r\n        uint256 openCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        // Count open requests\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) {\r\n                openCount++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Build array\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory openRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            openCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) {\r\n                openRequests[index] = coSigningRequests[i];\r\n                index++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return openRequests;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xf4f6da1bcbdc9158e8c10e236e5b0c8e51c25233c5c49ad1761c026d893c565d","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/CollateralManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./PriceOracle.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title CollateralManager\r\n * @notice Manages collateral deposits, withdrawals, and liquidations for lending platform\r\n * @dev Integrates with PriceOracle for real-time collateral valuation\r\n */\r\ncontract CollateralManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant LIQUIDATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"LIQUIDATOR_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    PriceOracle public immutable priceOracle;\r\n\r\n    // Collateral deposits\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CollateralDeposit) public deposits;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanToDepositIds; // loanId => depositIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userDepositIds; // user => depositIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Token information\r\n    mapping(address => TokenInfo) public supportedTokens;\r\n    mapping(address => uint8) public tokenDecimals;\r\n    address[] public supportedTokenList;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextDepositId;\r\n\r\n    // Liquidation parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; // 110% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO = 12000; // 120% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_BONUS = 500; // 5% bonus for liquidators\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000; // 100%\r\n\r\n    // Grace period before liquidation (to give borrower time to add collateral)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralDeposit {\r\n        uint256 depositId;\r\n        address depositor;\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        bool isLocked;\r\n        uint256 depositTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lockedTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct TokenInfo {\r\n        bool isSupported;\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount; // Max amount that can be deposited\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty; // Penalty on liquidation (basis points)\r\n        uint256 totalDeposited; // Total amount currently deposited\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralValue {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD;\r\n        uint256 lastUpdated;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CollateralDeposited(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralUnlocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        address liquidator,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 recoveredValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenAdded(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event TokenConfigUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error CollateralManager__CannotLiquidate();\r\n    error CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TransferFailed();\r\n    error CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _priceOracle) {\r\n        if (_priceOracle == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        priceOracle = PriceOracle(_priceOracle);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LIQUIDATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n\r\n        nextDepositId = 1;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add a supported collateral token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param decimals_ The token decimals\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount Maximum deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty Liquidation penalty in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function addSupportedToken(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint8 decimals_,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].isSupported)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n\r\n        // Verify token is supported by price oracle\r\n        if (!priceOracle.isSupportedToken(token)) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token] = TokenInfo({\r\n            isSupported: true,\r\n            maxDepositAmount: maxDepositAmount,\r\n            liquidationPenalty: liquidationPenalty,\r\n            totalDeposited: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        tokenDecimals[token] = decimals_;\r\n        supportedTokenList.push(token);\r\n\r\n        emit TokenAdded(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a supported token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Check no active deposits\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n                    supportedTokenList.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokenList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update token configuration\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount New max deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty New liquidation penalty\r\n     */\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Deposit collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param tokenAddress The address of the collateral token\r\n     * @param amount The amount to deposit\r\n     * @return depositId The ID of the created deposit\r\n     */\r\n    function depositCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 depositId) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[tokenAddress].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        TokenInfo storage tokenInfo = supportedTokens[tokenAddress];\r\n\r\n        // Check max deposit\r\n        if (amount > tokenInfo.maxDepositAmount) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        depositId = nextDepositId++;\r\n\r\n        deposits[depositId] = CollateralDeposit({\r\n            depositId: depositId,\r\n            depositor: msg.sender,\r\n            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,\r\n            amount: amount,\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            isLocked: false,\r\n            depositTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            lockedTimestamp: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        loanToDepositIds[loanId].push(depositId);\r\n        userDepositIds[msg.sender].push(depositId);\r\n\r\n        tokenInfo.totalDeposited += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens from user to this contract\r\n        IERC20(tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            address(this),\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralDeposited(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            tokenAddress,\r\n            amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return depositId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Withdraw unlocked collateral\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to withdraw\r\n     */\r\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 depositId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.depositor != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n\r\n        address token = deposit.tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount = deposit.amount;\r\n        address depositor = deposit.depositor;\r\n\r\n        // Update state\r\n        supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited -= amount;\r\n        delete deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens back to user\r\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(depositor, amount);\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(depositId, depositor, token, amount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Lock collateral when loan becomes active (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to lock\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function lockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n        if (deposit.loanId != loanId) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = true;\r\n        deposit.lockedTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralLocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Unlock collateral after successful repayment (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to unlock\r\n     */\r\n    function unlockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (!deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralUnlocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            deposit.loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate collateral for a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The outstanding loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param lender The address of the lender to receive funds\r\n     * @return recoveredAmount The amount recovered from liquidation in USD\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        address lender\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE)\r\n        nonReentrant\r\n        returns (uint256 recoveredAmount)\r\n    {\r\n        if (lender == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        if (depositIds.length == 0)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n        uint256 totalRecovered = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (!deposit.isLocked) continue;\r\n\r\n            // Check grace period\r\n            if (\r\n                block.timestamp <\r\n                deposit.lockedTimestamp + LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get collateral value\r\n            uint256 collateralValue = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Apply liquidation penalty\r\n            uint256 penalty = supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                .liquidationPenalty;\r\n            uint256 valueAfterPenalty = (collateralValue *\r\n                (BASIS_POINTS - penalty)) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n\r\n            totalRecovered += valueAfterPenalty;\r\n\r\n            // Transfer collateral to lender\r\n            IERC20(deposit.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(lender, deposit.amount);\r\n\r\n            // Update state\r\n            supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress].totalDeposited -= deposit\r\n                .amount;\r\n\r\n            emit CollateralLiquidated(\r\n                depositIds[i],\r\n                loanId,\r\n                deposit.depositor,\r\n                lender,\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                valueAfterPenalty\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Clear deposit\r\n            delete deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Clear loan deposits\r\n        delete loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n\r\n        return totalRecovered;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the USD value of collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return valueInUSD The total collateral value in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCollateralValue(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        uint256 totalValue = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit memory deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (deposit.amount > 0) {\r\n                uint256 value = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                    deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                    deposit.amount,\r\n                    tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                );\r\n                totalValue += value;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return totalValue;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get collateral deposit details\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit\r\n     * @return deposit The collateral deposit struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getCollateralDeposit(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit memory) {\r\n        return deposits[depositId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all collateral deposits for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return loanDeposits Array of collateral deposits\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory loanDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            loanDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return loanDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all deposits for a user\r\n     * @param user The user address\r\n     * @return userDeposits Array of user's deposits\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserDeposits(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = userDepositIds[user];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory userDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            userDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return userDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if collateral is sufficient for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param requiredRatio The required collateral ratio (basis points)\r\n     * @return isSufficient True if collateral is sufficient\r\n     */\r\n    function isCollateralSufficient(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        uint256 requiredRatio\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return true;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        uint256 actualRatio = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return actualRatio >= requiredRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate health factor for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @return healthFactor The health factor (10000 = 100%)\r\n     */\r\n    function calculateHealthFactor(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 healthFactor) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return type(uint256).max;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        healthFactor = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return healthFactor;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a loan is eligible for liquidation\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @return canLiquidate True if loan can be liquidated\r\n     */\r\n    function canLiquidate(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return false;\r\n\r\n        uint256 healthFactor = this.calculateHealthFactor(loanId, loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Can liquidate if health factor below threshold (110%)\r\n        return healthFactor < LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all supported collateral tokens\r\n     * @return tokens Array of supported token addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokenList;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get token information\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return tokenInfo The token info struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenInfo(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (TokenInfo memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens[token];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed collateral value information\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param amount The token amount\r\n     * @return collateralValue Struct with value details\r\n     */\r\n    function getCollateralValueDetails(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralValue memory) {\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n            token,\r\n            amount,\r\n            tokenDecimals[token]\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return\r\n            CollateralValue({\r\n                tokenAddress: token,\r\n                amount: amount,\r\n                valueInUSD: valueInUSD,\r\n                lastUpdated: block.timestamp\r\n            });\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xab99fbb0548117617b48c5e270ae9e97968940342d5fba3c9a16cb97b0b8dacc","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LendingPool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./CollateralManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LoanLogic.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ActiveOfferLib.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title LendingPool\r\n * @notice Core P2P lending pool with reputation-based matching\r\n * @dev Integrates with ReputationManager and CollateralManager\r\n */\r\ncontract LendingPool is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    CollateralManager public immutable collateralManager;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextOfferId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextLoanId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => LoanOffer) public loanOffers;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => Loan) public loans;\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userOffers;\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userLoans;\r\n\r\n    // Active offers lists\r\n    uint256[] public activeLenderOffers;\r\n    uint256[] public activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n    // Platform fee (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public platformFeeRate = 100; // 1%\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PLATFORM_FEE = 500; // 5% max\r\n\r\n    // Loan constraints\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_LOAN_DURATION = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_LOAN_DURATION = 365 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_INTEREST_RATE = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    address public feeCollector;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Enums ============\r\n\r\n    enum LoanStatus {\r\n        PENDING,\r\n        ACTIVE,\r\n        REPAID,\r\n        DEFAULTED,\r\n        CANCELLED\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    enum LoanType {\r\n        LENDER_OFFER,\r\n        BORROW_REQUEST\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct LoanTerms {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 principalAmount;\r\n        uint256 collateralAmount;\r\n        address collateralToken;\r\n        uint256 interestRate;\r\n        uint256 duration;\r\n        uint256 minReputation;\r\n        uint256 collateralRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct LoanOffer {\r\n        uint256 offerId;\r\n        LoanType offerType;\r\n        address creator;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct Loan {\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        LoanType loanType;\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        LoanStatus status;\r\n        uint256 startTime;\r\n        uint256 dueTime;\r\n        uint256 amountRepaid;\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId;\r\n        bool hasCoSigner;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed offerId,\r\n        address indexed creator,\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        uint256 principalAmount,\r\n        uint256 interestRate,\r\n        uint256 duration\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCancelled(uint256 indexed offerId, address indexed creator);\r\n\r\n    event LoanMatched(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        uint256 indexed offerId,\r\n        address indexed lender,\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 principalAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepayment(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepaid(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 totalRepaid\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanDefaulted(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PlatformFeeCollected(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 feeAmount);\r\n\r\n    event PlatformFeeRateUpdated(uint256 oldRate, uint256 newRate);\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error LendingPool__TransferFailed();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidFeeRate();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(\r\n        address _reputationManager,\r\n        address _collateralManager,\r\n        address _feeCollector\r\n    ) {\r\n        if (\r\n            _reputationManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _collateralManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _feeCollector == address(0)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        collateralManager = CollateralManager(_collateralManager);\r\n        feeCollector = _feeCollector;\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Offer Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Create a new loan offer or borrow request\r\n     * @param offerType Type of offer (LENDER_OFFER or BORROW_REQUEST)\r\n     * @param terms The loan terms\r\n     * @return offerId The ID of the created offer\r\n     */\r\n    function createLoanOffer(\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 offerId) {\r\n        // Validate terms\r\n        _validateLoanTerms(terms);\r\n\r\n        offerId = nextOfferId++;\r\n\r\n        loanOffers[offerId] = LoanOffer({\r\n            offerId: offerId,\r\n            offerType: offerType,\r\n            creator: msg.sender,\r\n            terms: terms,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userOffers[msg.sender].push(offerId);\r\n\r\n        // Add to appropriate active list\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            activeLenderOffers.push(offerId);\r\n\r\n            // Lender must lock funds\r\n            IERC20(terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            activeBorrowerRequests.push(offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCreated(\r\n            offerId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            offerType,\r\n            terms.principalAmount,\r\n            terms.interestRate,\r\n            terms.duration\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return offerId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel an active loan offer\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelLoanOffer(uint256 offerId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from active lists\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Return funds if lender offer\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCancelled(offerId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a loan offer and create an active loan\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer to accept\r\n     * @param collateralDepositId The ID of the collateral deposit (for borrowers)\r\n     * @return loanId The ID of the created loan\r\n     */\r\n    function acceptLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 loanId) {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender created offer, msg.sender is borrower\r\n            lender = offer.creator;\r\n            borrower = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n            // Check borrower's reputation\r\n            if (\r\n                !reputationManager.meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    offer.terms.minReputation\r\n                )\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n            }\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower created request, msg.sender is lender\r\n            lender = msg.sender;\r\n            borrower = offer.creator;\r\n\r\n            // Lender must provide funds\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                lender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Verify and lock collateral\r\n        if (offer.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            bool sufficient = collateralManager.isCollateralSufficient(\r\n                collateralDepositId,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount,\r\n                offer.terms.collateralRatio\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            if (!sufficient) revert LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n            collateralManager.lockCollateral(collateralDepositId, nextLoanId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Create loan\r\n        loanId = nextLoanId++;\r\n\r\n        loans[loanId] = Loan({\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            loanType: offer.offerType,\r\n            lender: lender,\r\n            borrower: borrower,\r\n            terms: offer.terms,\r\n            status: LoanStatus.ACTIVE,\r\n            startTime: block.timestamp,\r\n            dueTime: block.timestamp + offer.terms.duration,\r\n            amountRepaid: 0,\r\n            collateralDepositId: collateralDepositId,\r\n            hasCoSigner: false,\r\n            coSigner: address(0)\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userLoans[lender].push(loanId);\r\n        userLoans[borrower].push(loanId);\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate offer\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Transfer principal to borrower (minus platform fee)\r\n        uint256 platformFee = (offer.terms.principalAmount * platformFeeRate) /\r\n            BASIS_POINTS;\r\n        uint256 amountToBorrower = offer.terms.principalAmount - platformFee;\r\n\r\n        IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            amountToBorrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (platformFee > 0) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                feeCollector,\r\n                platformFee\r\n            );\r\n            emit PlatformFeeCollected(loanId, platformFee);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanMatched(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            offerId,\r\n            lender,\r\n            borrower,\r\n            offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return loanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Loan Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Repay an active loan (partial or full)\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param amount The amount to repay\r\n     */\r\n    function repayLoan(uint256 loanId, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        if (amount > remainingAmount) {\r\n            amount = remainingAmount;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.amountRepaid += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer repayment from borrower to lender\r\n        IERC20(loan.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepayment(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            amount,\r\n            remainingAmount - amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Check if fully repaid\r\n        if (loan.amountRepaid >= amountDue) {\r\n            _completeLoanRepayment(loanId);\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateLoan(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (block.timestamp <= loan.dueTime)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        // Liquidate collateral\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount = 0;\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            recoveredAmount = collateralManager.liquidateCollateral(\r\n                loanId,\r\n                unpaidAmount,\r\n                loan.lender\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.DEFAULTED;\r\n\r\n        // Apply reputation penalties\r\n        reputationManager.recordDefault(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Penalize co-signer if exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                loan.coSigner,\r\n                loan.borrower,\r\n                loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanDefaulted(loanId, loan.borrower, unpaidAmount);\r\n        emit CollateralLiquidated(loanId, loan.borrower, recoveredAmount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate total amount due for a loan (uint256) {\r\n        Loan memory loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (\r\n            loan.status == LoanStatus.PENDING ||\r\n            loan.status == LoanStatus.CANCELLED\r\n        ) {\r\n            return 0;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 interest = (loan.terms.principalAmount *\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n        return loan.terms.principalAmount + interest;\r\n    }\r\n    */\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a loan is past due\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return true if loan is past due\r\n     */\r\n    function block.timestamp > loan.dueTime;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get loan details\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return Loan struct with all details\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoan(uint256 loanId) external view returns (Loan memory) {\r\n        return loans[loanId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get loan offer details\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer\r\n     * @return LoanOffer struct with all details\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId\r\n    ) external view returns (LoanOffer memory) {\r\n        return loanOffers[offerId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all active lender offers\r\n     * @return Array of active lender offer IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getActiveLenderOffers() active borrow request IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getActiveBorrowerRequests()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return _getActiveOffers(activeBorrowerRequests);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all loans for a user (as lender or borrower)\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return Array of loan IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserLoans(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userLoans[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all active loans for a user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return Array of active Loan structs\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserActiveLoans(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (Loan[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory loanIds = userLoans[user];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        // Count active loans\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < loanIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (loans[loanIds[i]].status == LoanStatus.ACTIVE) {\r\n                activeCount++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Build array of active loans\r\n        Loan[] memory activeLoans = new Loan[](activeCount);\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < loanIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (loans[loanIds[i]].status == LoanStatus.ACTIVE) {\r\n                activeLoans[index] = loans[loanIds[i]];\r\n                index++;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeLoans;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get user's loan offers\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return Array of offer IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserOffers(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userOffers[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Admin Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update platform fee rate\r\n     * @param newFeeRate New fee rate in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function setPlatformFeeRate(\r\n        uint256 newFeeRate\r\n    ) external newFeeRate;\r\n\r\n        emit PlatformFeeRateUpdated(oldRate, newFeeRate);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update fee collector address\r\n     * @param newFeeCollector New fee collector address\r\n     */\r\n    function setFeeCollector(\r\n        address newFeeCollector\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeCollector == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        feeCollector = newFeeCollector;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Complete loan repayment and unlock collateral\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function _completeLoanRepayment(uint256 loanId) internal {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.REPAID;\r\n\r\n        // Unlock collateral\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            collateralManager.unlockCollateral(loan.collateralDepositId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Update reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Reward co-signer if exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(loan.coSigner, loan.borrower);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepaid(loanId, loan.borrower, loan.amountRepaid);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Validate loan terms\r\n     * @param terms The loan terms to validate\r\n     */\r\n    function _validateLoanTerms(LoanTerms calldata terms) internal pure {\r\n        if (terms.principalAmount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n        if (\r\n            terms.duration < MIN_LOAN_DURATION ||\r\n            terms.duration > MAX_LOAN_DURATION\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n        }\r\n        if (terms.interestRate > MAX_INTEREST_RATE) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n        }\r\n        if (terms.collateralRatio > 0 && terms.collateralRatio < 10000) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove offer from active list\r\n     * @param offerId The offer ID to remove\r\n     * @param offerType The type of offer\r\n     */\r\n    /*\r\n    function _removeFromActiveList(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal {\r\n        uint256[] storage activeList = offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER\r\n            ? activeLenderOffers\r\n            : activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < activeList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (activeList[i] == offerId) {\r\n                activeList[i] = activeList[activeList.length - 1];\r\n                activeList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n    */\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get active offers from list\r\n     * @param offerList The list of offer IDs\r\n     * @return Array of active offer IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function
